traceability.notes: docs/stories/001.0-DEV-PLUGIN-SETUP.story.md is a valid implementation story for the plugin foundation. The current code and tests implement all listed acceptance criteria and technical requirements: - Core plugin structure and metadata (REQ-PLUGIN-STRUCTURE, REQ-NPM-PACKAGE) are implemented in src/index.ts and validated by plugin-setup and plugin-default-export-and-configs tests. - ESLint v9 flat-config compatibility (REQ-ESLINT-COMPAT) is implemented via flat-config presets in src/index.ts and verified by tests/config/flat-config-presets-integration.test.ts. - A rule registry and configuration system (REQ-RULE-REGISTRY, REQ-CONFIG-SYSTEM) are present and tested. - The plugin is written in TypeScript with a proper build pipeline (REQ-TYPESCRIPT). - Comprehensive Jest-based test infrastructure exists and is passing (REQ-TEST-SETUP). - Robust error handling for rule loading and CLI usage (REQ-ERROR-HANDLING) is implemented and covered by dedicated tests. - User-facing documentation (README, ESLint 9 setup guide) and internal development guides (eslint-plugin-development-guide, custom-rules-development-guide) satisfy the documentation and user-experience acceptance criteria. Given the passing, story-specific tests and aligned documentation, this story is fully implemented in the current project state.
